acf.introduction: Partner with us to feature your products in premier homes, integrated into immersive visual tours that help you attract more clients effortlessly.

what_we_offer.heading: What We Offer
what_we_offer.content_1: Bring every detail to life through finishes and furnishings precisely embedded within DX LIVING's advanced 3D/4D and BIM ecosystem.
what_we_offer.content_2: Position your brand before the most selective architects, builders, and homeowners, precisely when it matters most.
what_we_offer.content_3: Gain privileged early access to DX LIVING's upcoming developments and forge enduring partnerships within an elite design network.

our_process.heading: Our Process: From Onboarding to Build
our_process.step_1_content: Register your company and product portfolio today through our official supplier application.
our_process.step_2_content: Each potential supplier undergoes a rigorous evaluation to ensure they meet our exacting standards of design excellence and superior quality.
our_process.step_3_content: Provide precise material specifications and curated samples for comprehensive premium review and approval.
our_process.step_4_content: Approved materials are seamlessly integrated into our 3D & 4D models, delivering unmatched precision and photorealistic visualisation.
our_process.step_5_content: We will present your vision with exceptional clarity, combining hyper‑realistic CGI and immersive VR to captivate and engage clients.
our_process.step_6_content: Our finalised projects proudly showcase the suppliers, recognising their role in bringing each design vision to life.

tiers.heading: Our Supplier Tiers
tiers.tier_desc_1: Showcase up to 5 of your material finishes as realistic textures. Users can easily drag and drop your supplied finishes into their curated designs within our applications.
tiers.tier_visibility_1: DX Interiors & DX Model Lite (Visibility)
tiers.tier_desc_2: One 3D/4D product is included at NO EXTRA COST, and is fully integrated across our applications. Enhance your product collections further with our premium options.
tiers.tier_visibility_2: DX Model & DX Model Lite (Visibility)

cta_banner.heading: BECOME A DX LIVING PARTNER TODAY
cta_banner.content: Submit your expression of interest to become a featured supplier on Australia's most digitally advanced residential projects.
